Exotic, but still loads Non-Basic Ammunition. A sealed Companion Chip plays a scripted girlfriend who talks to you through a bone speaker in the cheek rest; taking the chip out destroys it and the rifle for good. Bonding: once you score 10 kills with it, it counts as Excellent Quality in your hands. Upset it (damage it, neglect it, leave it unfired, feed it Junk Ammunition, fire another Sniper Rifle) and it may drop that bonus until you make amends.

A magenta collector's rifle with hearts on the grip. The legal team insists the voice at your ear is not a VI.

Class: Exotic Sniper Rifle • SMART
Range table: Sniper Rifle
Damage: 5d6
Built-in: Infrared Nightvision Scope, Smart Rebuild, Sniping Scope

Item Compendium (2070) • Weapons
